purpose: Expanded employer-first radar using current and historical role evidence. Inclusion does not require a current user-fit vacancy: employers can qualify through recurring relevant corporate functions plus credible compensation signals in Milan/Rome.

policy.core_principle: A company may deserve monitoring even if today's vacancies are not suitable, when its local organization repeatedly hires in relevant corporate functions and compensation evidence suggests attractive future upside.
policy.promotion: Promote into JW1-JW4 when the employer has a monitorable official source and sufficiently strong employer-level evidence; current perfect-fit vacancy is not required.
